beats.text: Quick guess: how much social media a day made students less lonely?
A hundred forty-three students. For three weeks, half of them used Facebook, Instagram and Snapchat as usual.
The other half: ten minutes per app, per day. Thirty minutes total. And their loneliness?
So you don't have to quit. Just cap it!

sources: Hunt, Marx, Lipson & Young (2018), No more FOMO: Limiting social media decreases loneliness and depression, Journal of Social and Clinical Psychology 37(10) – 143 students, 3 weeks; limit 10 min per platform per day (Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat) vs usual use; significant reductions in loneliness and depression.
